description: Estimates a Malaysian employee's monthly take-home pay from gross salary: EPF/KWSP, SOCSO/PERKESO, EIS/SIP, LINDUNG 24 Jam and PCB (monthly tax deduction), plus employer contributions. Pay dates 2026-06-01 to 2027-12-31; the date picks the tax year (YA2026 or YA2027 Belanjawan 2027). This is an ESTIMATE: PCB assumes the same salary every month from January and no TP1 reliefs. When you relay a figure, state the tax year and date used and pass on the warnings that affect it. Kira gaji bersih: KWSP, PERKESO, SIP, LINDUNG dan PCB. Set locale "ms-MY" for a Bahasa Melayu summary.

age60.description: Aged 60 or over: no employee SOCSO/EIS, employee EPF defaults to 0%.

children.description: Children claimed for PCB (RM2,000 relief each).

citizen.description: Malaysian citizen or PR. Others: EPF 2% employee and employer.

date.description: Pay date (YYYY-MM-DD) whose rules apply; picks the tax year. Supported 2026-06-01 to 2027-12-31. Use today's date for "now".

epf_rate.description: Employee EPF % (default 11; 0 from age 60; 2 for non-citizens).

lindung.description: Contributes to PERKESO LINDUNG 24 Jam (optional for local workers since 13 Jul 2026).

locale.description: Language of the summary and messages: en-MY or ms-MY. Keys and numbers are the same.

resident.description: Malaysian tax resident. Non-residents pay a flat 30% with no reliefs.

salary.description: Gross monthly salary in MYR (RM), before any deduction.

tax_category.description: single; married (spouse has no income, adds RM4,000 relief); married_spouse_working.

zakat.description: Zakat deducted through salary per month (RM); reduces PCB for residents.

name: estimate_take_home_pay
title: Malaysian take-home pay (gaji bersih) estimate
